literal_meaning: স্বর্ণ জন্মদাতা (gold-bearing or that which produces gold)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ভূমি স্বর্ণপ্রসূ, এখানে যেকোনো ফসল ভালোভাবে জন্মে।
বাংলার গঙ্গা উপত্যকা স্বর্ণপ্রসূ হিসেবে পরিচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: This land is swarnaprasu, where any crop grows abundantly.
The Ganges delta in Bengal is known as swarnaprasu for its fertility.
history: Derived from Sanskrit, often used in ancient texts to describe highly productive riverine soils in Bengal.
note: This term poetically elevates fertile land to one that yields treasures like gold.
